root.name: Owen Defense: Hekili-Loa Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 b6 2. d4 c5 3. dxc5 Nc6

overview: Black strikes at the d4 centre with 2...c5 and after 3.dxc5 plays Nc6, offering the pawn for quick development. White can hold the pawn with b4 or Nf3, and Black plays for ...Bxc5 or ...Qc7 or ...e6. It is an uncommon speculative gambit with a tempo spent on b6.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the c5 pawn with b4 or Nf3 and develop
Return the pawn if needed to complete development

black_ideas.idea: Use the b7 bishop on the long diagonal

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White a pawn up

character.notes: A pawn gambit early; the game is open and risky.

gambit.notes: White can keep the pawn with accurate play, though Black may recoup it.

soundness.notes: Probably dubious since Black has spent tempi.

structure.notes: The d-pawn is traded and lines open.

character.reason: A pawn is offered for development early.

gambit.reason: Black offers the c5 pawn, though it may come back quickly.

soundness.reason: Black loses time and a pawn with little in return.

plans.reason: Black wants development for the pawn.
